> This is a compact, custom-PCB handheld computer built around an RP2040. It combines a 128x64 OLED display, directional controls, action buttons, rotary encoder, audio output, status LEDs, and USB connectivity into a single programmable platform. The device is designed to run multiple small games and applications, with the PCB itself handling the complete user-interface and peripheral architecture.
